IRS990.Desc: EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM FUNDS (EA FUNDS) AND GIVING WHAT WE CAN (GWWC) ARE THE MAJOR GRANTMAKING PROGRAMS OF THE ORGANIZATION. EA FUNDS FUNDS SMALL OR EARLY STAGE PROJECTS FOCUSED ON IMPROVING THE LIVES OF PEOPLE IN EXTREME POVERTY, IMPROVING THE WELLBEING OF NON-HUMAN ANIMALS, SUPPORTING THE EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM COMMUNITY AND IMPROVING THE LONG-TERM FUTURE. GWWC INSPIRES DONATIONS TO THE WORLD'S MOST EFFECTIVE ORGANIZATIONS AND PROVIDES A PLATFORM FOR MAKING THOSE DONATIONS. WITH THE DONATIONS, THE ORGANIZATION MAKES GRANTS TO THE CHARITIES AND OTHER ENTITIES RECOMMENDED BY GWWC.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: CENTRE FOR EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM SUPPORTS THE EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM COMMUNITY. IT NURTURES SPACES WHERE PEOPLE CAN EXPLORE HOW TO APPLY THE IDEAS OF EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM TO THEIR FUTURE CAREERS, RESEARCH, OR DONATIONS. THESE SPACES INCLUDE EVENTS SUCH AS THE EA GLOBAL CONFERENCE, LOCAL COMMUNITY GROUPS, AND ONLINE SPACES SUCH AS THE EA FORUM.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: IN FURTHERANCE OF ITS MISSION, THE ORGANIZATION BEGAN A PROGRAM TO (1) GROW THE EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM COMMUNITY BY PROVIDING A FREE SPACE FOR INDIVIDUALS INCLUDING UNIVERSITY STUDENTS TO GATHER, NETWORK, AND LEARN ABOUT EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM, AND (2) PROVIDE A SPACE FOR UNIVERSITY AND NONPROFIT RESEARCH GROUPS FOCUSED ON LONG TERM RISKS TO HUMANITY (SUCH AS BIOSECURITY RISKS) TO MEET, WORK, AND ADVANCE CRITICAL IDEAS TO ADDRESS THESE RISKS.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: LONGVIEW PHILANTHROPY EDUCATES PHILANTHROPISTS ON CHARITABLE GIVING AND CONDUCTS RESEARCH INTO EXISTENTIAL AND CATASTROPHIC RISKS. THIS INCLUDES EDUCATING PEOPLE ABOUT THE WORLD'S MOST IMPORTANT PROBLEMS, HOSTING EVENTS TO CONNECT PHILANTHROPISTS AND EXPERTS, AND RESEARCHING AND RECOMMENDING GRANTS. 80,000 HOURS PROVIDES RESEARCH AND SUPPORT TO HELP PEOPLE ENTER CAREERS THAT EFFECTIVELY TACKLE THE WORLD'S MOST PRESSING PROBLEMS BY PROVIDING 1-ON-1 CAREER ADVISING, AS WELL AS MAINTAINING A BLOG, A PODCAST, AND A CURATED JOB BOARD OF HIGH-IMPACT OPPORTUNITIES. ASTERISK IS A QUARTERLY JOURNAL OF WRITING AND CLEAR THINKING DESIGNED TO EDUCATE THE PUBLIC ABOUT THINGS THAT MATTER. THE FORETHOUGHT FOUNDATION AIMS TO PROMOTE AND COMMUNICATE ACADEMIC AND NONACADEMIC WORK THAT ADDRESSES THE QUESTION OF HOW TO USE OUR SCARCE RESOURCES TO IMPROVE THE WORLD AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE. FORETHOUGHT SUPPORTS AND PROMOTES INDIVIDUALS AND INSTITUTIONS WORKING ON GLOBAL PRIORITIES RESEARCH, FURTHERS AND DEVELOPS EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM AND LONG-TERMISM IDEAS, AND PROMOTES AND PRESENTS THE IDEAS OF EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM AND LONG-TERMISM IN SOCIAL AND TRADITIONAL MEDIA, IN PERSON, AND WITHIN ACADEMIA. THE CENTRE FOR THE GOVERNANCE OF AI ("GOV AI") AIMS TO DEFINE AND MAP THE FIELD OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) GOVERNANCE AND ADDRESS THE MOST IMPORTANT AND NEGLECTED RESEARCH QUESTIONS. GOV AI FELLOWSHIPS AND PRIZES SUPPORT PROMISING EARLY-CAREER RESEARCHERS WORKING ON AI GOVERNANCE. GOV AI RUNS SEMINARS AND CONFERENCES TO CONNECT THE FIELD OF AI GOVERNANCE BETTER AND BUILD A THRIVING GLOBAL RESEARCH COMMUNITY.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: SCHEDULE C, PART II-B, LINE 1 - THE ORGANIZATION ENGAGES IN GRANT-MAKING ACTIVITIES TO FURTHER ITS CHARITABLE PURPOSES. CERTAIN GRANTS MAY INVOLVE SOME LOBBYING ACTIVITY, FOR EXAMPLE, GRANTS TO SUPPORT PASSING ANIMAL PROTECTION LAWS.

THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE HAS DETERMINED THAT THE ORGANIZATION IS DESCRIBED IN SECTION 501(C)(3) OF THE CODE AND, ACCORDINGLY, IS GENERALLY EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME TAXES UNDER THE PROVISION OF SECTION 501(A) OF THE CODE. HOWEVER, CERTAIN ACTIVITIES NOT DIRECTLY RELATED TO THE ORGANIZATION'S TAX-EXEMPT PURPOSES ARE NOT EXEMPT AND ARE SUBJECT TO FEDERAL INCOME TAXES. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES THE TAX BENEFIT FROM UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS ONLY IF IT IS MORE LIKELY THAN NOT THAT THE TAX POSITIONS WILL BE SUSTAINED ON EXAMINATION BY THE TAX AUTHORITIES, BASED ON THE TECHNICAL MERITS OF THE POSITION. THE TAX BENEFIT IS MEASURED BASED ON THE LARGEST BENEFIT THAT HAS A GREATER THAN 50% LIKELIHOOD OF BEING REALIZED UPON ULTIMATE SETTLEMENT. THE ORGANIZATION RECOGNIZES INTEREST AND PENALTIES, IF ANY, RELATED TO INCOME TAX MATTERS IN OTHER EXPENSE. THE ORGANIZATION HAD NO UNRECOGNIZED TAX BENEFITS AT JUNE 30, 2024 OR 2023. THE ORGANIZATION FILES FORM 990 IN THE U.S. FEDERAL JURISDICTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: DURING THE FISCAL YEAR, THE ORGANIZATION MAINTAINED A GRANTS DUE DILIGENCE AND MONITORING PROCESS AIMED TO ENSURE EXPENDITURE RESPONSIBILITY AND THAT EACH FOREIGN GRANT FULFILLED THE ORGANIZATION'S CHARITABLE PURPOSES AND COMPLIED WITH ITS LEGAL AND REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS. SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION CONDUCTS DILIGENCE ON EACH GRANT TO ENSURE IT WILL FURTHER THE CHARITABLE PURPOSES OF THE ORGANIZATION. THE ORGANIZATION REQUIRES A GRANT AGREEMENT FOR EACH GRANT THAT SPECIFIES THE PURPOSES AND PERMITTED USES OF THE GRANT. THE ORGANIZATION ALSO COLLECTS BOTH INTERIM AND FINAL REPORTS FROM GRANTEES TO CONFIRM THE APPROPRIATE USE OF FUNDS.

THE ORGANIZATION SHARES A COMMON CHARITABLE MISSION WITH EFFECTIVE FOUNDATION (EV UK), AND BOTH ENTITIES SEEK TO FURTHER THOSE CHARITABLE PURPOSES THROUGH THE PRINCIPLES OF EFFECTIVE ALTRUISM. IN CARRYING OUT THIS SHARED MISSION, THE ORGANIZATION AND EV UK COLLABORATE WITH EACH OTHER ON VARIOUS PROJECTS AND ACTIVITIES PURSUANT TO AN AFFILIATION AGREEMENT. NOTWITHSTANDING THAT THEY ARE LEGALLY SEPARATE ENTITIES THAT NEED TO INDEPENDENTLY APPROVE ALL ACTIVITIES UNDER THIS AFFILIATION, THE ENTITIES HAVE AGREED THAT THEY MAY SHARE CERTAIN SERVICES OR RESOURCES (INCLUDING STAFF TIME) TO FURTHER THE CHARITABLE GOALS OF BOTH ENTITIES. TO THAT END, EV UK HAS DONATED CERTAIN OF ITS STAFF TIME TO EV US TO ACHIEVE SUCH SHARED CHARITABLE PURPOSES AS REFLECTED IN PART VII. EV US HAS CORRESPONDINGLY ACCOUNTED FOR THIS DONATED TIME IN ITS FINANCIAL STATEMENTS, INCLUDING AS DISCLOSED IN SCHEDULE D, PARTS XI AND XII.

OUT OF AN ABUNDANCE OF CAUTION, DUE TO US INTERNAL REVENUE CODE RULES REGARDING BENEFITS PROVIDED TO DISQUALIFIED PERSONS, WE REQUESTED THAT THIS GRANT AMOUNT BE REPAID. MS. GREAVES HAS REPAID THE GRANT IN FULL.
THE AMOUNT REPRESENTS THE NUMBER OF ACTUAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED AND NOT THE NUMBER OF ITEMS RECEIVED FOR EACH CONTRIBUTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY EV US'S FINANCE TEAM AND LEGAL COUNSEL, EXTERNAL ACCOUNTANTS, EXTERNAL LEGAL COUNSEL, AND PRESENTED TO THE BOARD FOR REVIEW. AFTER ANY AND ALL QUESTIONS OF THE BOARD HAVE BEEN ADDRESSED, THE BOARD APPROVES THE FORM 990 FOR FILING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAINTAINS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY THAT REQUIRES DIRECTORS AND OFFICERS TO DISCLOSE ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST AND PROVIDES PROCEDURES FOR ADDRESSING DISCLOSED CONFLICTS, PERIODICALLY REVIEWS PRACTICES TO ENSURE COMPLIANCE, AND ENFORCES PROCEDURES FOR DEALING WITH VIOLATIONS OF THE POLICY. THE ORGANIZATION ALSO HAS A CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IN ITS STAFF HANDBOOK THAT REQUIRES EMPLOYEES TO DISCLOSE ACTUAL OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS OF INTEREST AND INCLUDES PROCEDURES FOR BOTH EMPLOYEES AND MANAGERS TO ADDRESS DISCLOSED CONFLICTS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE COMPENSATION FOR THE ORGANIZATION'S CEO WAS SUBJECT TO DELIBERATION AND DECISIONMAKING AND CULMINATED IN BOARD ACTION APPROVING THE COMPENSATION THROUGH A UNIVERSAL WRITTEN CONSENT. FOR KEY EMPLOYEES, COMPENSATION IS DETERMINED BY ONE'S LEVEL (AS DETERMINED BY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES) AS WELL AS OTHER DEFINED CRITERIA, INCLUDING COMPARABLES, RELEVANT PRIOR EXPERIENCE, SPECIAL SKILLS, AND COST OF LIVING. HUMAN RESOURCES AND MANAGEMENT ARE INVOLVED IN THE FINAL DETERMINATION ON COMPENSATION FOR KEY EMPLOYEES.

THE ASTERISK PROJECT AIMS TO PUBLISH MATERIALS IN ITS QUARTERLY JOURNAL, ASTERISK MAGAZINE, USING EVIDENCE AND REASON TO EMPOWER ACTIONS THAT HELP OTHERS AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE. IT RELIES ON THIRD PARTY GRANT FUNDING FOR ITS OPERATING COSTS. THE REVENUE GENERATED FROM ITS SUBSCRIPTIONS DURING THIS FISCAL YEAR WERE APPROXIMATELY 10 PERCENT OF THE COSTS TO PRINT AND DISTRIBUTE ITS PRINT MAGAZINES. ASTERISK DOES NOT GENERATE ANY REVENUE FROM SELLING ADVERTISEMENTS.
